notes.title: Update info for "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: TAISHI with Power Up Kit" (05/30/2019)
notes.content:
The following updates were made. (Ver.1.0.0.7)

■Expansions/Adjustments
- Adjusted the CPU's break out rate for sieges.
- Improved the list to show the years an officer has served in the Posting command.
- Adjusted the check when renegotiating with a Castle Lord.
- Changed the consumption of the Tactics gauge for "Enrage" to 4 and  "Shared Fate" and "Naoejo" to 5



■Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug not allowing "Marry" to be performed.
- Fixed so that the traits "Logistical Talent" and "Supply Line Master" will take effect as long as someone in the army has it, even if it is not the commander.
- Fixed so the effects of the Training Grounds facility extended only to neighboring bases.
- Fixed a bug in districts with bases that allowed losing bases troops to immediately recover after losing a battle.
- Fixed a bug where a command to circle to the enemies rear during battle was not functioning.
- Fixed a bug where some negotiations were in a state difficult to complete.
- Fixed so that new Force bases don't change when changing countries.
- Fixed a bug where some officers pictures didn't change properly.
- Fixed so that the ground making effects of Kanto Plains Clearing were able to be used.
- Fixed the explanation for "Glory of the Taikou".
- Fixed a bug where Iizaka Neko, Kichino, and Lady Suwa did not make an appearance when playing Maiden mode.
- Fixed a bug where projections for the farmlands exceeded the max when using the agriculture command.
- Fixed a bug where progress into some trade zones were removed after absorbing a subject force.
- Fixed a bug where a Grand trade zone was not dismantled after losing a trade zone, like it should have been. 
- Fixed a bug where an officer's status was different than expected during the Posting command.
- Fixed a bug where the base info was not displayed at the screen for reinforcement selection.
- Fixed a bug where a Title was not assumed even though the requirements were met.
- Fixed a bug where the required number of units for some tactics was different than expected.
- Fixed a bug where your army's units' morale hits 0 during a siege when "Betray" is used.
- Fixed a bug during the tutorial where negotiations couldn't be completed.
- Fixed a bug where the Battle of Nagashino was triggered at inappropriate times.
- Changed the location of some officers after the event "Zentokuji no kaimei".
- Changed the contents of Help>Military "Marching Traits" to reflect the power-up kit.
- Fixed the location of some officers starting points for each scenario.
- Fixed other small mistakes and bugs.

notes.title: 『信長の野望･大志 with パワーアップキット』アップデート情報（2019/04/11）
notes.content:
以下のアップデート（Ver.1.0.0.6）を行いました。

■機能拡張／調整
[list]
[*] 農兵による兵糧収入を大幅減少
[*] 戦法ゲージの消費量を「逆撫で」は「4」、「一蓮托生」と「直江状」は「5」に変更
[*] 作戦「囮挑発」、戦法「逆撫で」を発動している部隊が撤退した場合、効果が解除されるよう変更
[*] 作戦「神出鬼没」「十面埋伏」「森林強襲」の奇襲成功時の戦法ゲージ増加量を「1」に変更
[*] 戦法「突撃」「赤備突撃」「雷神」の効果時間を調整
[*] 大命「忍暗躍」の行軍速度減少の効果を上昇
[*] 「国替」した勢力のAIを調整
[*] 一部の家宝による大名が所持することで得られる家臣の忠誠上昇効果を減少
[*] CPUが講和の交渉を行う頻度を調整
[*] 追放した武将が登用・内応・一部の城主交渉に応じないよう変更
[*] 決戦中、最も引いた視点でも兵数を表示するよう変更
[*] その他、細かい改善や調整
[/list]

■不具合修正

[list]
[*] 縁組できる武将がいるのに「縁組」コマンドが実行できないことがある不具合を修正
[*] 顔画像追加ツールのデータが保存ができない場合がある不具合を修正
[*] 史実合戦「川中島の戦い」（武田家）で啄木鳥作戦が使用できるよう修正
[*] 収支報告で、「総構え」の兵糧収入が「漁村収入」に表示されていたのを修正
[*] 新勢力作成の拠点選択で郡情報が表示されない不具合を修正
[*] シナリオ設定で言行録を「発生しない」に設定すると、初志言行録を「発生する」にしても発生しない不具合を修正
[*] 想定外の勢力が包囲網に参加することがある不具合を修正
[*] 包囲網に参加していなくても包囲網の標的勢力と講和できなくなる不具合を修正
[*] 複数の勢力が関白となることがある不具合を修正
[*] 大命「夜叉羅刹」の効果が「大名が総大将時」のみ発揮されるよう修正
[*] その他、細かい誤字や不具合などを修正
[/list]

- Fixed a bug where the cursor appeared over the water when returning to normal view from policy view using a certain order.

notes.title: Update information (06/28/2018)
notes.content:
■Function expansions/adjustments

・Changed so that when a Treasure is requested from a negotiation,  alliances and trade agreements are not asked for in exchange.
・Added an "Arrival of Guns" event and revised musket related procedures.
・Added a time period to the return to castle command for armies.
・Improved the UI in order to make it easier to recognize Harvest and needed income during the Recruit command.
・Improved the UI in order to make it easier to understand Trade Zone resources in Trade Zone view.
・Changed it so that reports on the completion of other clans' Grand trade zones are made only through dispatches.
・Changed it so that Battle reports for clans not bordering the player's clan are not made.
・Changed so that war declarations unrelated to the player's clan are not acted out. 
・Improved the UI in order to make the useable tactics easier to understand.
・Changed to skip the command phase during the strategy "Full Charge" (No commands can be issued).
・Improved so that the position of the Tactic button does not change.
・Improved so that the Auto Command during battles is maintained.
・Improved the list display to make selecting tactics easier.
・Improved UI to make it easier during marching to know the number of selected units.
・Improved UI to make it easier when selecting cities of origin for the Posting command.
・Changed to allow checking of untriggered Quests in the "Quest Compendium."
・Changed the reporting on the movement of refugees during battles and sieges.
・Changed the message displayed when the castle lord surrenders during a siege.
・Changed the narration when the negotiation command focuses on Peace.
・Adjusted the camera stage to increase by one when carrying out a development command.
・Adjusted the amount of horses and muskets upon refund.
・Changed so that report is displayed upon the completion of a castle when one is being constructed.
・Changed so that sorting the officer list uses the surnames rather than given names.

■ Fixed bugs

・Fixed a bug where the game would occasionally stop if the base that was the goal of an NPC army is dismantled.
・Fixed a bug where the game would freeze the game advances when foreign negotiations cannot be done and the game advances.
・Fixed a bug where officers could not be selected with the Goodwill command.
・Fixed a bug when automating agriculture, where clearing is done at a base that has already acted.
・Fixed a bug there you would lose when skipping battles, even if you had an overwhelming advantage. 
・Fixed a bug where explanations for the development commands displayed in front of district info.
・Included an explanation regarding development command shortcuts in Help's "(Other) Game Flow"
・Fixed a bug where changing the resolution during the development command would cause the × button to disappear.
・Fixed a bug where Megohime's face graphic displays dark when expanded in the officer directory. 
・Changed the marriage alliance of the Ikeda and Mori clans in scenario "Tennōzan" and "The Battle of Okitanawate."
・Changed the alliance relations of the Ikeda, Yūki,  Date and Mori clans in the scenario "The Battle of Okitanawate."
・Fixed a bug where during the change in morale after battle, the policy effect displays as "Trait"
・Fixed the reading and explanation for Fire Arrows.
・Corrected the misspelling of Tamekage Nagao's traits.
・Corrected misspellings in the lines used by maiden officers in the tactic  "Shared Fate."
・Fixed a bug where the affiliated base was boot listed at a maiden's coming of age. 
・Fixed the trade narration when you have insufficient gold
・Fixed a bug where the "horses" and "muskets" purchased through trade were not recorded in the Balance report.
・Fixed the "Draft Exemption" traits display.
・Fixed a bug where "Remove" could not be selected after moving from form unit to Army info and then returning. 
・Fixed a bug where the development display in the unit info of the agriculture view would always show the next month's projected values.
・Fixed a bug where even if you canceled after selecting a new castle lord with the posting command, the new castle lord display does not return to the previous value.
・Fixed a bug where the correct BGM did not play properly until you moved forward after loading saved data in the middle of a game. 
・Fixed lines when suggesting tactics "Cavalry Muskets", or "Excitable". 
・Fixed a bug where Ii Naomori was not set as foster father to Ii Naochika.
・Fixed a bug where the narration "there is a base without officers on the front lines" narration was triggered even for bases not on the front lines.
・Fixed a bug where advice and narration were not displayed when a trade zone's production was max and no more could be invested. 
・Fixed a bug for the "Lord of the West Sea" resolve's "Survey" trait.
・Fixed a bug where the event for the "Cast no Stones" trait effect was not triggering.
・Fixed a bug where the event for the "People First" trait effect was not triggering.
・Fixed a bug where the event for the "Council Governance" trait effect was not triggering.
・Fixed a bug where the upgrade narration was different than expected when the base endurance were all A. 
・Fixed a bug where the Surplus Farmland from the agricultural command was the sum of the Surplus Farmland and the Militia.
・Fixed a bug where the expected value for gold was wrong when a trade zone command was cancelled.
・Changed the text for the "The Tiger's Beautiful End"
・Fixed a bug where you move toward the enemy after using the Caution tactic.  

・Fixed a bug causing the game to freeze after right clicking the bottom bar during Form Unit
・Fixed a bug causing the game to freeze after clicking Invest or Monopolize right after pressing ESC during the Commerce command.
・Fixed display problems in the Negotiation info of the "Diplomacy View."
・Changed the Resolve name display for successors with the Retire command.
・Fixed a bug where some of the tactic descriptions did not display when focused on in the unit list during battle.

・Fixed various other misspellings and bugs

・Fixed a bug  where clearing was suggested even when a labor exemption was in place
